A foramen/pit on the posterior surface of the basal tubera is anatomically distinct from the broader basioccipital depression between the foramen magnum and basal tubera.

M19 C122 is retained as the historical compound parent that combines depth of the postaxial cervical pneumatic excavation with subdivision by accessory laminae. M26 decomposes those dimensions into MC0916 and MC0924.
M19 C176 is retained as the historical broad parent for anteriormost-caudal camellation. M26 decomposes it into centrum-specific MC0917 and neural-arch-specific MC0937.

serial_scope_and_threshold_modified: Both derive from the Wilson/Upchurch neural-spine-height lineage and measure neural-spine height relative to centrum length. M19/M26 broaden the serial scope from sacrals to posterior dorsals and/or sacrals and repartition the threshold states.
